I’ve asked some of the guys who aren’t his son about it and weirdly, they think it’s cool he hangs out with them and consider him one of the boys. Apparently he had his kids really young and was married already in his early 20s and didn’t have the opportunity to get drunk and party with his friends. So now he does it with his son and his friends. Next time this group hits me up, I really want to ask if his dad will be there. I love my friends and still want to hangout with them, but The dad being around ALL THE TIME is too much. Aita for asking my friend if his dad is going to be there before I agree to hangout with them?
